data.one_liner: Integrate navigation, floor plans, POIs, and turn-by-turn directions.
data.what_it_does: Provides indoor navigation and wayfinding using Situm's positioning and mapping tools. Renders floor plans, points of interest, and routes with turn-by-turn directions inside a webview component.
use_when: You need indoor navigation and wayfinding with floor plans and POIs.
You want to integrate Situm's positioning services into a Flutter application.
avoid_when: You are building simple outdoor-only maps where standard mapping packages suffice.
You do not want to configure native location permissions and platform-specific webview options.
strengths: Plug-and-play navigation experience with floorplans, POIs, and routes.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Breaks compatibility with the previous Situm Flutter Wayfinding plugin.
Requires specific native permission configurations and minimum SDK levels.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Situm credentials, adding location and sensor permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and configuring minimum SDK versions.
